The '''Osara Mundicide''' was a [[Mundicide|devastation]] of a [[Planet/Legends|world]] that occurred during the [[Tenth Alsakan Conflict]]<ref name="EGTW" /> in the vicinity<ref name="Battlenamia" /> of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Osara system/Legends|Osara system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the culmination of a period of the [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]]-long [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|struggles]] between the planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and their respective allies over the [[Politics/Legends|political]] control over the Republic. That period began after the Republic's victory over the [[Kumauri Empire]] in a [[Galactic Republic–Kumauri Empire war|war]] around [[10,000 BBY]] that saw the latter faction use [[Mass-driver cannon/Legends|mass-driver cannons]] for the [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] of planetary surfaces with accelerated [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]]. After the war, the Republic adopted the technology in its own [[Republic Military/Legends|military]], and it became a grim new tactic employed during the Coruscant-Alsakan conflicts. Simultaneously, the fear of bombardment led to rapid development of the technologies of [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shields]] and planet-based [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] such as [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Osara Mundicide was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" />
